api_access.reason: lock/dependency/plan-create/list are admin-tier; approve_migration_plan and execute_migration are enforced super_admin-only inside the route itself (COMMAND_ROLES map), same pattern as storage-intelligence's move_safe_to_trash.

full unauthenticated table dump if ever exposed again — kept to the tightest tier
role assignment — must not be self-service by admin/employee

api_access.mechanism: X-DNA-Token header — see services/supabase/api-tokens.ts, not a Supabase Auth session

capability_access_note: Authority for each BUSINESS TOOL in the Application Workspace (/workspace). Read only by core/navigation/resolveCapabilityAccess.ts — no component may hardcode a role list (same rule as route_access/api_access above). DEFAULT IS DENY: a tool key that is not listed here is not shown. Every role set below mirrors the authority of the existing plane the tool's data/actions already come from, verified from source, not invented: /api/admin/* + /api/document + /api/chat all call requireAuth(ADMIN_TIER) and registry route_access '/admin' is the same three roles — so all 14 declared tools are admin-tier today. When a tool genuinely gains a wider plane (e.g. a partner-visible screen), update THIS registry, never the component. Roles here are a filter on presentation only; the server routes keep their own requireAuth() check — this registry never replaces an API guard.

capability_actions.note: CAPABILITY/ACTION AUTHORITY ของ control-surface สองใบ (owner directive 2026-10-12: ยุติแผนแยก Source Code แบบตัดความสัมพันธ์ทั้งหมด — คง shared capability ไว้ครบ แล้วแยกเฉพาะ CONTROL SURFACE). อ่านที่เดียวโดย core/auth/surfacePolicy.ts และบังคับที่ middleware.ts (API + Runtime จริง ไม่ใช่แค่ซ่อนปุ่ม). แยกสิทธิ์ตาม capability + action ไม่แยกตามชื่อ AI provider — ไม่มี role/สิทธิ์ใหม่ถูกสร้างขึ้น
capability_actions.authority: Identity/Authority กลางเดิม = core/auth/session.ts (Supabase session) + requireAuth/requireAuthPage + route_access/api_access/capability_access ของไฟล์นี้ · อำนาจแก้ source ยังเป็น chain เดิม: requireAuth(ADMIN_TIER) → app/api/admin/ide/_lib/fsSecurity.ts → change-set/review → build → scripts/deploy-gate.ts · โมเดล surface อ้าง control/owner-surface-separation (STRICT_OPERATIONAL_DEVELOPMENT_SURFACE_SEPARATION_V1) ใน dna-os-step2
capability_actions.enforcement: core/auth/surfacePolicy.ts#decideSurfaceAction (ตัวตัดสินใจ อ่านไฟล์นี้ไฟล์เดียว) + middleware.ts (เรียกทุกคำขอ /api/admin/* ก่อนถึง route) · ตรวจด้วย scripts/surface-policy-test.ts
capability_actions.fail_closed: ไม่มี cookie / ค่าผิด / อ่านไม่ได้ = operational (Business) = DENY ทุก developer-plane write

workspace_landing.note: Single source of truth for role -> post-login destination. Read only by core/auth/resolveDestination.ts — no route file may hardcode its own landing map (same rule as route_access above). super_admin/admin/employee land directly on /admin/relationships (Navigation redesign, owner, 2026-07-16: Relationship Workspace is the system Home), not /admin, so the login flow itself never passes through app/admin/page.tsx's own redirect.

history.2026-07-08: Created for TASK-001 (Plan Lock 1/3). Replaces the old admin_session presence-only cookie check with real Supabase Auth + role checks, and formalizes the Role/Permission Registry required by TASK-001's Definition of Done.
history.2026-07-14: Added workspace_landing (Enterprise Workspace Architecture, Phase 1) — role-to-destination is now data here, not code in app/login/page.tsx's old ROLE_HOME. /business intentionally has no entry: no role lands there today (see the Phase-1 architecture proposal's orphaned-workspace finding) and this phase does not invent one.
history.2026-09-23: Added capability_access + capability_access_note (SLICE-1 of the locked Full System Upgrade Line, owner decision D1=A): the NEW Business Workspace (/workspace) now derives which business tools a role may see from this registry through core/navigation/resolveCapabilityAccess.ts instead of showing every tool to every authenticated user. Presentation filter only — no role moved, no route_access/api_access entry changed, and every server route keeps its own requireAuth() guard.
history.2026-10-12: Added route_access /developer + capability_actions (FINAL ARCHITECTURE ALIGNMENT — preserve shared capabilities, separate control surfaces). ไม่มี role ใหม่ ไม่มีสิทธิ์ใหม่: /developer ใช้ admin_tier ชุดเดียวกับ /admin, business.write/connector.execute/document.generate ยังเป็นสิทธิ์เดิมทุกบรรทัด สิ่งที่เพิ่มคือ (ก) ประกาศ DENY ของ developer-plane actions (source.modify / git.push / deployment.execute / developer.worker.execute / developer.workflow.execute) สำหรับ Business surface และ (ข) บังคับที่ middleware.ts บนทุกคำขอ API จริง อ่านผ่าน core/auth/surfacePolicy.ts ไฟล์เดียว fail-closed
